Both choices feel right. Putting the note in the same edit screen as the title and description is convenient — it's all "my stuff about this link" in one place. And having the note show right there on the card is exactly what I'd want; a quick glance reminds me why I saved it and what I meant to do with it. That little "My note" line did just what I hoped.

One thing I'd want as these notes grow: sometimes my note is more than a single sentence. I might want a couple of bullet points, or to make a word or two stand out, or drop in a link. So I'd like to be able to give the note a little basic formatting and have it actually show up formatted when I look at the card or the bookmark — not just come out as one flat run of text. As long as that's in the picture, this is great.
